title: When you want to release your FHSS amount

sections.heading: When you want to release your FHSS amount
sections.text:
There are 5 steps to releasing first home super saver amounts from your super fund.

QC107682

Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

When you're ready to withdraw your FHSS amounts, you need to apply for a FHSS determination.

After you have a FHSS determination and are ready to access your FHSS amount, you can then request a release.

Understand the timeframe in which you must either sign a contract or recontribute the released FHSS amount.

How you receive your FHSS release and how it is taxed.

Understand what you need to include on your tax return about FHSS amounts and what we do with this information.
